title: An issue in @justice8096/sagemath-mcp-server 1.0.1 allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the escapeShellString and sanitizeCode… (CVE-2026-106763)
description: A vulnerability in @justice8096/sagemath-mcp-server version 1.0.1 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code through the escapeShellString and sanitizeCode functions. The flaw enables high-impact consequences including confidentiality, integrity, and availability compromises. The vulnerability requires network access and user interaction, with a high attack complexity.
aiSummary: The @justice8096/sagemath-mcp-server package version 1.0.1 contains a vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-106763. This flaw allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by exploiting the escapeShellString and sanitizeCode functions. The CVSS 3.1 score is 7.5, indicating a high severity with network attack vector, high attack complexity, no privileges required, and user interaction needed. The vulnerability impacts confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.
aiImpact: Successful exploitation can lead to full compromise of the affected system, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely. This results in high confidentiality, integrity, and availability impacts.
